Results-driven Network Analyst with 6+ years of experience, prepared for senior- level responsibilities. Skilled in designing, implementing, and managing complex network infrastructures to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and security. Strong expertise in network troubleshooting, network security, and infrastructure optimization. A collaborative team player with the adaptability to meet changing business and technical requirements while consistently delivering high-quality results.

CERTIFICATIONS

Cisco Certified Network Associate (Routing & Switching: 200-125) | Cisco ID: CSC0135768848

Cisco Certified Specialist – Enterprise Core (350-401) | Cisco ID: CSC015210853 | Valid till May 2029

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Routing & Switching: VLAN, VTP, STP, MSTP, RSTP, Port-Channels, HSRP, VRRP, SSO, VRF, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, VXLAN,DNS,DHCP

Security: VPN, DMVPN, IPSec, GRE Tunnels, Palo Alto Firewalls, NAT, SSL Decryption, URL Filtering, HA Failover

Wireless: Cisco WLC 5500 Contorllers, Aruba Access Points, Aruba 7200 Controllers

SD-WAN: Aruba Silver Peak, Cisco Viptela

Monitoring Tools: Spectrum, NetBrain, Splunk, Grafana,NetBeeze

Ticketing Tools: ServiceNow

Load Balancer: Good understanding of F5 technologies and load balancer operations.

Automation : Basic Knowledge on Ansible , Json ,XML, YAML ,Python

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

2025-06 - Current

2022-10 - 2025-05

2022-03 - 2022-10

2020-01 - 2022-03

Senior Network Analyst Merck • Configured and installed routers, Cisco Catalyst 9500 & 9300 switches,

Palo Alto firewalls, and Aruba Silver Peak devices. • Performed LAN refresh activities across multiple sites. • Performed firmware and patch upgrades after stability analysis and

vendor consultation.

Optimized network performance through assessments and upgrades. • Handled incidents in ServiceNow by following ITIL processes, and successfully resolved P1 and P2 incidents within SLA timelines.

Took the lead in handling the clean-up of Spectrum alerts within the

allocated time.

Network Security Engineer Merck • Part of a NOC team responsible for managing 50,000+ network devices

globally.

Worked on Cisco switches, routers, Silver Peak SD-WAN, Palo Alto

devices, and Aruba controllers.

Participated in multiple LAN refresh and network migration activities. • · Designing and applying solutions/policies that would meet or exceed functional, operational, performance, analytical, and security requirements while minimizing technical risks in implementation.

· Configured and maintained virtualization on firewalls like context and

VRF solution on routers/switches to segregate & interconnect the network.

Configured and supported VLANs, 802.1Q trunking, inter VLAN routing,

Static Routing, OSPF, and basic BGP

Performed real time monitoring of routers, switches, firewalls, wireless

controllers, WAN and MPLS links.

Network Engineer 1 Oracle Cerner Pvt Ltd • Worked as a Network Administrator supporting enterprise client

infrastructure.

Provided troubleshooting support and ensured SLA compliance. • Handled incidents in ServiceNow following ITIL processes • Coordinated with ISPs/telecom vendors for MPLS and leased line issues.

Network Engineer Microland Pvt Ltd • Provided L2-level troubleshooting support across multiple enterprise sites. • Managed LAN, WAN, Cisco routers, switches, ASA firewalls, F5 load

balancers, and wireless controllers.

Performed Cisco IOS upgrades for multiple customers. • Coordinated with Cisco TAC and handled RMA activities. • Installed wireless access points for HUL and GE projects.

EDUCATION

2019-01

Bachelor of Engineering: ECE CMR College of Engineering And Technology - Bangalore VTU

Personal Details

Date of Birth: 26/10/1995

PERSONAL DETAILS

Languages Known: English, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada, Tamil

DECLARATION

I hereby declare that the information provided above is true and correct to the best of my knowledge and belief. Narendra D
